subject: POC starting lineup: finalize owners, success criteria & new dates
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@saasco.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@saasco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC starting lineup — proposed kickoff windows & success criteria (draft)

Hi Michael / Priya,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion we want to get the POC kickoff on the calendar and lock owners + success criteria so we can hit the timeline. My ask in this message is twofold: 1) confirm which of the proposed kickoff windows works for your team, and 2) confirm who on your side will be the point people for engineering, procurement, and security so we can include them in the invite.

Proposed kickoff windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred — demo + deploy plan + success criteria)
- Option B: Wed Apr 21, 15:00–16:00 PT (backup)

Attached: POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf — draft success criteria and a short suggested owner matrix. High level items we want to agree at kickoff:
- Basic integration (+ API key exchange)
- Latency & throughput targets for a representative workload
- Data handling and retention boundaries (what goes to Redwood logs)
- Acceptance tests + timeline for a 2-week trial run

If procurement needs a pre-kickoff artifact (PO template / SOW), please flag and we will surface it.

Will follow up internally to confirm SE availability.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
(attach) POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@saasco.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@saasco.com>
Cc: Jason Kim <jason.kim@saasco.com>, Amit Verma <amit.verma@saasco.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC starting lineup — proposed kickoff windows & success criteria (draft)

Thanks Ava — appreciate the clarity.

Quick notes from our side: procurement (cc'd Jason) needs at least one week to process any SOW/PO paperwork after the kickoff. Security (cc'd Amit) also asked for a short network/data flow diagram and confirmation of where logs are stored before they sign off.

Because of that, the earliest practical kickoff for us is the week of Apr 19. Of your two windows, Apr 20 at 10:00 PT looks promising but I need to confirm with our infra engineer (Priya) — she is listed here. If possible, could we tentatively pencil in Apr 20 10:00 PT and I will confirm by EOD? If procurement needs more time we may ask to move to Apr 26.

Also — Jason will want the PO template and a brief list of the deliverables we expect during the trial. Can you share a one-pager for procurement?

-Michael
Director, Platform Engineering | SaaSCo

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-11T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC starting lineup — proposed kickoff windows & success criteria (draft)

Thanks Michael — penciled.

Stephanie / SEs: are you available for Apr 20 10:00 PT? If not, can you confirm the backup window? Also, if security needs a network/data flow diagram we can push the infra/architecture doc and the storage/retention notes prior to kickoff.

Ava — I can draft a one-page procurement summary (deliverables + acceptance criteria) if that helps Jason move faster.

-Rishi

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-11T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC starting lineup — proposed kickoff windows & success criteria (draft)

Hi all — I can be on Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 PT. Backup I have Apr 21, 15:00–16:00 PT.

Plan for kickoff: 30–35 minute demo of the integration path + 20–25 minute working session to review success criteria and assign owners. I'll bring:
- SE preflight checklist (sandbox access + API key steps)
- Demo running against a small sample dataset
- Quick performance benchmarking plan for the 2-week trial

Attaching SE_preflight_checklist.xlsx and will share the network/data diagram excerpt for Amit within 24 hours.

- Stephanie
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attach) SE_preflight_checklist.xlsx (xls)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@saasco.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@saasco.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC starting lineup — owners, success criteria & timeline (internal + external view)

Looping in a draft owners matrix so everyone knows who is accountable during the POC. Ava — once Michael confirms, please send the calendar invite with the owners pre-filled.

Draft Owners / Roles (suggested):
- Redwood AE (engage/procurement): Rishi Malhotra — owns PO and contract follow-through
- Redwood SE (technical delivery): Stephanie Nguyen — owns demo + technical validation
- Redwood Engineering Liaison (performance & infra): Marcus Lin — owns acceptance tests & perf benchmarks
- SaaSCo Engineering: Priya Desai — owns on-prem infra config + test data
- SaaSCo Procurement: Jason Kim — owns PO timing and payment terms
- SaaSCo Security: Amit Verma — final sign-off on data flow and retention

Success criteria (short):
1) Integration: API keys exchanged, sample call succeeds with expected outputs
2) Performance: median latency < 150ms on representative sample (token-limited test)
3) Data: retention window confirmed; logs routing clarified
4) Acceptance: mutually signed short SOW or PO within 7 business days of successful trial

Timeline (proposed):
- Apr 20: Kickoff (agree owners & run initial integration)
- Apr 21–May 4: 2-week trial execution + daily syncs as needed
- May 5: Acceptance check & SOW/PO execution

Attach: POC_Owners_Matrix.csv (updated).

Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
(attach) POC_Owners_Matrix.csv (csv)

Priya: can you please confirm any special network constraints; Amit: if you need the full infra diagram I will share internally but Stephanie said she'd provide the excerpt.

Ava — please send a calendar invite for Apr 20 10:00 PT with the proposed agenda and owners. After kickoff Jason will circulate the PO timeline; we expect to finalize PO within 7–10 business days if the trial meets the acceptance criteria.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

-Michael
